verdict.rationale: Trilegal's own pages document Tier 1 Corporate/M&A work for promoters and entrepreneurs, plus PE exit execution via trade sales, secondaries, IPOs and mergers, including deals involving venture-backed companies such as the Meesho reverse merger. Public-offering experience appears only as one exit route listed on the investor-side PE page, with no dedicated capital-markets or IPO page and no company-side IPO track record. Missing for 10: a dedicated public-offering/capital-markets page, documented IPOs for venture-backed companies from the company/founder side, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: We advise on inbound and outbound mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, entry strategy and strategic alliances
We assist private equity investors in executing successful exits across diverse routes: trade sales, secondary transactions, IPOs and mergers, and promoter buy-backs.

Trilegal provides end-to-end private equity expertise ranging from fund formation and structuring, due diligence, capital deployment, fund financing, ongoing regulatory compliances, investment restructurings, to exits
